title: Storm Drainage/Flooding Complaint
description: Use this service request to report flooding from rising water in creeks or an overflow of water in the street due to inadequately sized drainage system. Use this for non-emergency services only. The estimated response time for this service request is 5 business days.

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request about nonemergency creek or street flooding.
actions.why: For nonemergency flooding from rising water in a creek or street overflow caused by inadequate drainage capacity within the City service area. The 311 request form asks whether an inlet, drain, or culvert may need cleaning, whether water is moving or standing, whether flooding is happening now, and whether water has entered a building.
actions.why_not: The online form for "Storm Drainage/Flooding Complaint" requests is described for nonemergency concerns only and displays a jurisdiction alert for a location outside the City service area.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Under "Other Requests", choose "Storm Drainage/Flooding Complaint"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Under "Other Requests", choose "Storm Drainage/Flooding Complaint"
